decisions.reason: The accelerator was publicly shown on the home page and builds on the firm's established offer, so management is likely to keep it and attribute any early setbacks to temporary startup issues rather than write off the visible commitment.

Although only on its own page, the bio-based binder represents a substantial R&D investment into a CO2-negative product aligned with the firm's circular direction, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely while results can still be viewed as preliminary.

The infectious waste plant was prominently launched on the home page with a specific partnership and is close to the firm's core expertise, so the high public commitment and sunk costs make management keep it despite any early disappointment.

As a mobile mechanical recycling plant central to the firm's modular recycling technology and featured on the home page, this product has the strongest public commitment and strategic centrality, leaving management highly unlikely to drop it this year.
